metadata.prompt: Kunan watapi allintachu paranqa icha manachu?
metadata.transcription: "Manan ashwan yachanichu chaykuna qhawayta. Hatunmamaymi niwan: ""kay pachanchis nishuta tiqrakushan millayta, manan yachakunchu imapis"", nispa."
